planets.name: K2-277 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of K2-277 with a 6.33-day year, found in 2018.

text.card: K2-277 b was found in 2018 by K2 as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around K2-277. Its orbit and size follow Thygesen et al. 2023's fit, the archive's default.
